# `Q-5-43` — Invalid book-scope Value

> A `book-scope` value was not `book` or `chapter`.

## What this means

A `book-scope` value was ignored because it is not `book` or `chapter`.

`none` is not accepted as input: it is what a render reports when no book mode applies (the project is not a book, or the file is not in the chapter list). A value that is not a string is invalid too. The next layer down (runtime, document, `_metadata.yml`, project) applies instead.

## How to fix

Use `book` or `chapter`, or remove the key.
